<div style="background-color:;height: 15px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="nd_options_section nd_options_text_align_center">
	<a style="border: 1px solid;border-radius:px;letter-spacing:4px;line-height:11px;font-size:11px;background-color:;padding:15px 20px;margin:;color:" rel="" href="https://www.kiteboracay.com/wing-foiling/" class="nicdark_display_inline_block  nd_options_font_weight_lighter nd_options_second_font nd_options_disable_lateral_border ">LEARN MORE</a>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div><div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div> <h1 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:50px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-50 nd_options_first_font ">BORACAY WIND FORECAST</h1> <div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element text-center" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>The main kiteboarding season in Boracay is from November to March, during the Amihan Northwest Monsoon. Kiting happens on world-famous Bulabog Beach &#8211; which is 1.5 kilometers long and sheltered by an outer reef. Windspeeds typically range from 15 to 25 knots, with the strongest from December to January. The wind drops during the summer months of April and May. From June though to October, kiting happens on White Beach as the winds change to the Habagat Southwest Monsoon.<br />
Check out the live forecast below.</p>
		</div>
	</div>
